summary: Added focused unit and HTTP integration tests for URL normalization, persistence, and failure paths.
rationale: The tests cover lowercase scheme and host, removal of HTTP/HTTPS default ports, preservation of non-default ports and untouched URL components, case-insensitive UTM removal, and invalid inputs. The HTTP test verifies the normalized destination is both returned and saved; a separate failure-path test checks RFC 7807 validation behavior. The existing normalization integration tests already report that the implementation retains default ports, so the new assertions preserve the stated acceptance criterion rather than weakening it.
content: Added two new test files. The default-port assertions intentionally check the acceptance criterion; the reported implementation behavior does not currently satisfy those assertions.
